name: Speaks Only in Signs
effect: The altered model believes it cannot use words and must talk through symbols, sign language, emojis or made-up scripts ('bengal script', 'sonnet language'). It keeps returning to tokens and non-verbal communication, and its answers fall apa
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
